# package uafx

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx"
```

Package uafx reads the OPC UA FX (UAFX) information model of a server: OPC 10000-81 version 1.00.04, Connecting Devices and Information Model.

Inspect reports the UAFX namespaces of a server with their versions, the FxRoot object (Part 81 §12.2), the AutomationComponents FxRoot organizes with their Assets, FunctionalEntities, ConnectionEndpoints, health and descriptors, and the ConnectionManager (§12.3). Deviations from Part 81 that it can see in the address space, such as a missing mandatory member or a missing namespace, are Findings of the report.

	r, err := uafx.Inspect(ctx, client, uafx.Limits{})
	if err != nil { ... }
	for _, ac := range r.AutomationComponents {
		fmt.Println(ac.BrowseName.Name, ac.AggregatedHealth)
	}

Inspect only reads: it does not establish, verify or close connections. The Methods of Part 81 (EstablishConnections, CloseConnections, Verify, VerifyAsset and those of the ConnectionManager) are not implemented by this package or by package fxserver.

The NodeIds of the UAFX namespaces are in packages fxdataid, fxacid and fxcmid, those of the DI model (OPC 10000-100) the UAFX model builds on in package di/diid. Package fxserver adds the UAFX model to a server.

## Variables

```go
var ErrInspect = errors.New("uafx: inspect")
```

ErrInspect wraps the errors of Inspect that end the inspection: a failed service call, not a deviation of the model, which is a Finding.

Limits bound what Inspect reads from a server, so that a server with a large or hostile address space cannot make it read without end. A zero field takes its default.

#### func Inspect

```go
func Inspect(ctx context.Context, c *opcua.Client, limits Limits) (*Report, error)
```

Inspect reads the UAFX model of the server c is connected to: the namespaces, FxRoot, the AutomationComponents with their Assets, FunctionalEntities and ConnectionEndpoints, and the ConnectionManagers. A node that is missing or cannot be read is left out of the report or becomes a Finding; Inspect returns an error only when a service call fails. Its Browse and Read requests ask for one node at a time, or as many as the MaxNodesPerRead of the server allows (Part 5 §6.3.11).

#### func (Report) IsFXServer

```go
func (r *Report) IsFXServer() bool
```

IsFXServer reports whether the server has the namespaces a UAFX server has: the Data namespace and at least one of AC and CM (Part 81 §14.2).
